method: The denominator corpus is the tot pin worktree /Users/oobi/Documents/affine-lang-tot-pin at 6d0d48d, read and never built in place.  dev/denominators.sh re-measures the raw figure inside every gate run.  It reads dev/denominators.json through /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -P with the json module.  It lists the corpus with /bin/ls -1 PIN/lib/*.ml PIN/lib/*.mli piped to LC_ALL=C sort, takes the bare file names, counts them, totals them with wc -l, and hashes them with cat of that sorted list piped to shasum -a 256.  It holds the count against tot_corpus.files, the total against tot_corpus.lines and the digest against tot_corpus.sha256, and it prints DENOM-ERROR with both values and exits 3 before any copy on a mismatch.  It then copies the files with mkdir -p and cp to $TMPDIR/kite-denom-$$, with /tmp as the fall-back when TMPDIR is unset, and orders the copy with zsh dev/pin-dune.sh -C COPYDIR ocamldep -sort FILES.  The compile command is zsh dev/pin-dune.sh -C COPYDIR ocamlfind ocamlopt -c -package str FILES in that order, one process per run, with the .cmi and .cmx files overwritten each run;  Str ships with OCaml 5.3.0 and is not a third-party package.  One untimed pass warms the .cmi files, and zsh dev/bench.sh raw_ocamlopt COMMAND with RUNS 5 times five runs after its own warm-up, with time.perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run of /bin/zsh -f -c COMMAND under /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -P and stdin, stdout and stderr on /dev/null.  A non-zero exit prints DENOM-ERROR and exits 4.  rm -rf removes the copy, and the script prints DENOM raw_ms_per_kloc=.. median_ms=.. lines=.. files=.. sha=.. and NUMSHA sha=.. lines=.. files=1, where raw_ms_per_kloc is median_ms divided by lines over 1,000 to three decimals.  The runner dev/pin-dune.sh puts the switch /Users/oobi/.opam/ctxcat-ocaml/bin first on PATH, clears the user chpwd hooks, cds into the named directory and execs the command.  raw_ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc 174.4 is the 2026-09-05 probe 1 reference, kept as the recorded reference and re-measured every run;  it is never the FLOOR denominator.  kanon_ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc 1641.599 is frozen and serial and is the RATIO denominator, and kanon_ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc_parallel 712.803 is informational, and both print on line 2 of a gate run and are never gated (M0-PLAN.md:76 and :108).  kite_corpus is the Stage A PLACEHOLDER pin:  examples/m0-spine.kite holds two comment lines and no declaration, so the empty program of D-A-12 is the spine that Stage A freezes, and Stage B replaces the three keys with the keys of the 1 kloc spine and re-freezes the sidecar.  That is the one denominators.json edit M0 allows, and dev/M0-BUILD-LOG.md records it.  dev/DENOMINATORS.sha256 holds one row, shasum -a 256 denominators.json written from inside dev/, and the check is zsh -c "cd dev && shasum -a 256 -c DENOMINATORS.sha256".
